##### Project general facts

Riviera Beachfront by Azizi is a collection of three residential towers along the waterfront of a Riviera-inspired community, forming an elegant architectural landmark beside the lagoon. Contemporary design with panoramic glazing and dynamic facade lines gives the towers a light, modern character, while each rises above three basement levels and a ground floor to twenty residential floors and a roof. The collection offers studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments, together with retail units on the lower levels.

Residents enjoy swimming pools with a children's pool, fully equipped fitness centres, an outdoor yoga area and Zen gardens for relaxation. Direct access to the lagoon beach, tennis and basketball courts, children's play areas, an outdoor cinema and barbecue areas add variety, while green parks, walking paths, supermarkets, shops, cafes and restaurants along the boulevard create a vibrant, resort-style setting with everything within walking distance.

Apartments feature functional layouts, modern interiors and floor-to-ceiling glazing that fills the living spaces with natural light and frames views of the lagoon and the city. Italian marble flooring, quartz countertops and quality wood joinery reflect a strong focus on refined detailing. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and built-in appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Azizi Riviera is a large waterfront community within Meydan One in Mohammed Bin Rashid City, inspired by the French Riviera and built around a crystal lagoon. A long boulevard lined with cafes, boutiques, supermarkets and restaurants, landscaped parks, walking paths and a lagoon beach create a lively yet relaxed setting, with everyday needs within walking distance of every building.

Al Khail Road and Meydan Road connect residents with the wider city. The Meydan Hotel and Meydan Racecourse are close by, Downtown Dubai, The Dubai Mall and Business Bay are a short drive away, and Dubai Design District, Dubai Creek Harbour and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable driving distance for work, leisure and travel.

Azizi Riviera is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the most popular mid-market waterfront addresses close to Downtown Dubai. Ready homes with lagoon views, integrated retail and an established community attract professionals and families, supporting steady rental demand. Competitive prices and a central location underpin attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners and investors.
